---
title: "A11y in a deck"
subtitle: "Every control, live"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: default
    slide-number: true
    revealjs-plugins:
      - a11y
    revealjs-a11y:
      skip-navigation: true
      focus-indicators: true
      font-size-controls: true
      font-selection: true
      text-spacing: true
      link-highlight: true
      transcript: true
      pointer-indicator: true
      alt-text-warnings: true
      menu:
        enabled: true
        shortcut: a
        position: right
---

## Try the controls

Press <kbd>A</kbd> for the settings menu, or use the shortcuts directly.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Reach the skip link |
| <kbd>+</kbd> <kbd>-</kbd> <kbd>0</kbd> | Font size up, down, reset |
| <kbd>T</kbd> | Transcript |
| <kbd>P</kbd> | Pointer indicator |
| <kbd>A</kbd> | Settings menu |

## Links are underlined

`link-highlight` underlines every [link](https://quarto.org) so colour is not the only thing distinguishing it.

## Fragments are announced

- []{.fragment} A fragment.
- []{.fragment} Another.

With `announce-fragments`, each is announced to a screen reader as it appears.

## Preferences persist

High contrast, font size, font family, text spacing, link highlight, and the cue toggles are kept in the browser, so they survive a reload.
